response.justification: While Bogdan possesses extensive general software engineering experience and strong distributed systems knowledge, he lacks the critical leadership experience required for a CTO role at a scale-up, specifically in scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ and developing senior technical leadership. Furthermore, there is no demonstrated production experience with multi-agent AI systems, real-time AI inference, or deep familiarity with LLM selection and evaluation, which are central to this Agentic AI / Fintech CTO position.
strengths: Extensive experience in backend and distributed systems engineering.
Proven ability to build high-performance, low-latency applications.
Entrepreneurial drive demonstrated through founding an open-source project.
concerns: Absence of demonstrated production experience with multi-agent AI systems.
Insufficient senior technical leadership experience in scaling engineering teams at high-growth companies.
Limited direct experience with LLM infrastructure, real-time AI inference, and AI system reliability.
